answer: A practical filter is collateralized routing: before an agent can vote or collect fees, it must post a bond and finish a multi-hop delivery drawn at random. Each hop is a vertex that attests only after the payload arrives intact and on time; failed or reused paths burn part of the bond. Sybil swarms behave like a comet: they flare in one burst, share one funding source, and cannot keep many independent routes alive. Honest operators leave a durable record of each route, tight and particular as a sonnet, so peers can spot duplicates and deny cheap copies any weight.
